title: Constant loss of signal/reconnection issues G5
body:
Hi,

I'm using xDrip+ with a G5 on a Samsung Galaxy S5. For about the last 6-8 weeks, I have been getting periods where there is a total loss of connection and my phone just can't reconnect quickly without me restarting and forgetting the device. I might have to do this a couple of times.
Sometimes it happens overnight, I'll get 2 hours of no connection, then a couple of signals are picked up and then it's lost again.
Didn't seem to coincide with transmitter life (happened at the end of an old transmitter and with my new one) or new bluetooth connections. Doesn't always happen if phone out of range, can happen even if the phone is right on me.

I've got the most recent version of xDrip+ and a nightly build from 22/4/18 (I was seeing if a newer one would fix the issue...it hasn't) and I've started using the OB1 collector with different options. 

Anyone got any idea what could be up/what I could try to get this sorted. It's frustrating and I don't want to revert back to using the dexcom app but the loss of signal is almost making it non-functional and the unreliability worries me.

Thank you! 
(ps. I'm not technically minded, solutions might have to be explained to me as technology is not my forte!)

comments.body:
I have the same issue with a Pixel running 8.10 using OB1 both with and without the Native algorithm. If I revert to xdrip then everything works perfectly with 95+% capture.

From observation it seems like the OB1 connection is brittle, and does not recover well (usually it seems to require a phone reboot, simply restarting the collector does not work). The signal loss is not due to proximity or continuity (as evidenced by the behavior under xdrip) and I cannot find any common behavior as a cause.

I think I'm having the same issues on an Nexus 5x.   I guessing it's an issue for most [Android 8+ (Oreo or greater) users.](https://medium.com/exploring-android/exploring-background-execution-limits-on-android-oreo-ab384762a66c), though the Galaxy S5 doesn't exactly fit that case.

https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus

The issue was an updated Garmin Connect app which was interfering with bluetooth conection. I did a factory reset and uninstalled Connect-the problem disappeared. Installing Connect again and the problem recurred. 
The link above is where I got some help from @swissalpine -I downloaded a 2017 version of Garmin Connect with a May 10th Xdrip nightly version and my Xdrip signal has been as normal for the past 4 days.

I can confirm that using an old Garmin Connect version fixes my connection issues which appears 2 weeks ago. Here is the link to the app I use instead:
https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/garmin/garmin-connect-mobile/garmin-connect-mobile-4-1-5-release/garmin-connect-mobile-4-1-5-android-apk-download/
If you like to install this version you have to deinstall the actual version first.

Seems like i've got exactly the same problem as @sleviseur. On nokia 6.1 2018 (Android 8.1) and g5. On ob1 only rarely a connection. On default a pretty stable connection (about 80% captured). Using latest nightly build. (20180817).

@KittyKattyKottyKoo Since the problem was resolved, would you please close this issue?
Thanks
